level4.h1: Look around carefully. Something on the fllor might be useful.
level4.h2: F picks up items, E interacts. The wire connected to that door looks interesting. Pick up items to and try pressing E.
level4.h3: Use dog form to follow scent trails. Only cat form can fit through vents.
level4.h4: The garbage room is too stinky for cat. Dispose of the garbage in dog form, then follow the new scent trail
level4.h5: Find the vent after disposing garbage, go through as cat, then enter the button sequence shown on the board from left to right.

level5.h1: Only one form can use the bio scanner. Look around the office carefully for interactive items
level5.h2: The PC on the upper floor is interactive. Find the right file to send — not all attachments are the right size
level5.h3: The printer room is now unlocked. Pick up the paper you see and bring it to the printer as a human
level5.h4: Kenji left something behind after his outburst. The tank in the lab looks fragile — one good hit should do it
level5.h5: You need two ID cards for the dual scanner at the end of the lab. One comes from Kenji's mess, one from the scientist after breaking the tank with the wrench

level6.h1: Parkour through the boxes to get inside. Check every locker — one has something useful inside
level6.h2: The chef won't let just anyone into the kitchen. You need to look the part first
level6.h3: The chef said don't get trigger happy — but the bell is there for a reason. Ring it when you're ready to move on
level6.h4: The bunkers are now open. Switch to dog form up there to sniff out something hidden
level6.h5: Use the access card you found to unlock the control room, then interact with the control panel to trigger the final sequence

level4.h1: You've already cracked the code once... what if you thought about it differently?
level4.h2: Every direction has an opposite. What happens if you reverse your thinking entirely?
level4.h3: Try the opposite of the directions given on the board. Start left to right again.

level5.h1: The scientist's research notes list some interesting components...
level5.h2: Where does the item listed usually show up. Can it be heard?
level5.h3: Listen carefully near the lab tanks. Cat form might be small enough to investigate the vents on the right side
level5.h4: In cat form go right in the lab all the way to the wall and there will be a vent.

level6.h1: The bookshelf in the control room area is hiding something. Try interacting with it as a human
level6.h2: Read the safe instructions carefully. The bunker nameplates hold the answer
level6.h3: First Impressions only - First character/number, letters and then numbers - code has all the letters and then all the numbers
level6.h4: Start low - bottom first, always left to right - read from left to right, end at the anchor - last digit is from the captains bunk.
